overview: TradeNest Naturals supplies premium dehydrated Nagarmotha powder processed from mature Cyperus rotundus tubers. As an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter in India, we follow a rigorous six-step process including controlled drying, grinding, and sieving. The resulting fine brownish-grey powder features an earthy, woody aroma, standardized 80-100 mesh size, and moisture content below 8 percent for superior industrial consistency.

We specialize in bulk supply and OEM and private label packing for international distributors and brand owners. Our production infrastructure easily accommodates custom mesh specifications and varied packaging formats, from small retail pouches to bulk containers. With complete export documentation support, reliable quality inspection, and a low minimum order quantity of 5 Kg, we ensure streamlined international procurement for your business.
highlights: Characteristic warm, earthy, and woody aroma
Derived from dehydrated Cyperus rotundus tubers

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for Nagarmotha powder?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity is 5 Kg for standard grades, accommodating both trial evaluations and commercial bulk shipments.

faqs.q: Can you provide custom mesh sizes for Cyperus rotundus powder?
faqs.a: Yes. While our standard specification is 80 to 100 mesh, we can adjust our grinding and sieving processes to meet your requirements.

faqs.q: What packaging formats are available for bulk export?
faqs.a: We supply material in 25 kg multi-wall bags, 25 kg HDPE containers, 5 to 10 kg bags, as well as customized retail pouches and jars.

faqs.q: Do you provide product samples before commercial orders?
faqs.a: Yes, product samples are available upon request to allow industrial evaluation of mesh, aroma, and consistency.

faqs.q: What are the recommended storage conditions and shelf life?
faqs.a: The product has a shelf life of 24 months when kept in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture.

faqs.q: Does TradeNest Naturals provide private label and export support?
faqs.a: Yes, as an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter, we offer OEM packaging, custom branding, and full export documentation support.
